title: List of lifted literals
statement: Let $n$ and $a$ be nonnegative integers, and let a DNF term on $n$ coordinates be given. The list of its lifted literals is obtained by lifting each literal to the first $n$ coordinates of the enlarged set of $n+a$ coordinates, preserving their order.
